dialogues.speaker: Player
dialogues.text: What has the expeditionary force been up to recently?

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: This expedition is finally coming to an end, and many of our Knights can't wait to go home.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: However, per the Grand Master's orders, this camp is to remain operational as an outpost for gathering Abyss-related intel.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: Several of our Knights have already volunteered to stay behind... To be honest, I am somewhat surprised by the number. We even had to draw lots to determine who would take the first round of duty.

dialogues.speaker: Anselm
dialogues.text: I will also stay behind with them to finish the work of setting up this stronghold.
